landing.heroTitle: Make every interview a training session that counts
landing.heroDesc: Driven by your resume and target role: live avatar multi-round interviews, per-round review, evidence-based scoring, review practice and formal retries. MianGeDan — interview a few more rounds, worry a little less.
landing.heroNote: Users under 16 can only use the sample walkthrough without signing in.
landing.feature1Title: Driven by your resume and JD
landing.feature1Desc: Upload your resume and paste the job description. We parse them, exclude sensitive fields, and build a plan matched to your goal.
landing.feature2Desc: Licensed fixed characters, dynamic personas and real-time audio/video with voice answers, interruption and subtitle revision.
landing.feature3Desc: Six-dimension anchored scoring with a dual threshold, traceable per-question evidence, and practice fully separated from formal retries.
landing.feature4Desc: Three isolated data regions, a consent centre and append-only audit. Raw audio/video is not saved by default.
landing.demoDesc: Experience the full flow from project creation to report viewing with synthetic materials. No real personal data is involved.
landing.footerDesc: MianGeDan — real-time AI mock interview training.

auth.subtitle: Sign in to create interview projects and start training
auth.agreement: By continuing you agree to the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy. Recording, organisation sharing and model training consents are asked separately and are never bundled with sign-up.
auth.ageNote: The minimum age for personalised services is 16.
auth.thirdPartyFallback: Third-party sign-in unavailable? Use email verification instead.
auth.signInError: The code is wrong or has expired. Please try again.

dashboard.title: Your interview projects
dashboard.desc: Start a new mock interview here, or pick up where you left off.
dashboard.emptyDesc: Create your first project: upload a resume, paste a JD, and start your first mock interview in minutes.
dashboard.noResultsDesc: Try adjusting company, status or language filters.
dashboard.deleteDialogBody: Project materials and progress will be removed. An active interview will be terminated.

projectNew.title: Create an interview project
projectNew.desc: Upload a resume and paste the job description. Materials are first scanned in isolation, then parsed into editable structured data.
projectNew.dropHint: Drop a file here, or click to browse

reasons.encrypted: file is encrypted and cannot be read
reasons.masked: file is disguised as another type

projectNew.jdHint: Paste the full JD text to build the job profile and interview plan
projectNew.jdPlaceholder: Paste the full job description here…

validation.noResumeOrJd: Provide at least a resume or a JD
validation.resumeUploading: The resume is still scanning. Please wait.
validation.jdTooShort: The JD needs at least 50 characters to parse

review.title: Confirm the parsed result
review.desc: Your materials have been parsed into structured data. Low-confidence fields are highlighted — please confirm each one.
review.parseFailedHint: Your original material is kept. You can retry the failed step or edit manually.
review.excludedFields: These sensitive categories never enter the interview context
review.excludedList: Phone, email, ID numbers, full addresses, photos, sex, marital status and other protected attributes
review.confirmHint: After confirmation the material version freezes, and the interview plan is generated from the confirmed profile.
review.missingImpactDesc: Some materials are missing. A degraded mode will be used.
review.missingFull: Both resume and JD are missing: a generic interview template will be used.
review.missingJdOnly: JD missing: the job profile will be inferred from the resume and marked as AI-derived.
review.missingResumeOnly: Resume missing: a generic role interview will be used.
review.agreeDegraded: I understand the impact and agree to continue

plan.title: Multi-round interview plan
plan.desc: Review and adjust rounds, roles, difficulty and duration. Once confirmed the plan freezes; scoring algorithm and thresholds cannot be changed.
plan.notReadyHint: This round is missing a coverage plan or rubric; confirmation is blocked.
plan.confirmDialogBody: After confirmation, rubrics, weights, rounds and coverage plans freeze and cannot change once started.
plan.frozenHint: The plan is confirmed and frozen. This version will be used for the session.

precheck.title: Final checks before you start
precheck.desc: Check your devices, network and avatar connection. Camera and microphone can be turned off without any scoring penalty.
precheck.speaker: Speaker
precheck.networkPoor: Network quality is poor. Connect to a more stable network or use text mode.
precheck.accommodationsHint: These settings apply to this round and are never treated as scoring weaknesses.
precheck.entitlementHint: Credits are reserved at confirmation; faults and waiting are not billed.
precheck.entitlementInsufficient: Not enough credits. Purchase more or choose a shorter round.

room.title: Live interview
room.exitDialogBody: Exiting marks this round as evaluation incomplete (not a failure) and settles only actual usage.
room.question: Interviewer question
room.questionHint: The question stays visible and can be reviewed
room.revisionHint: Once the next main question starts, this transcript freezes and scoring uses the revised text.
room.noToolsHint: No tools configured for this round
room.systemPausedHint: Auto-recovery is in progress. This time is not billed and does not affect scoring.
room.reconnectHint: After a refresh or drop, you can resume at the last confirmed turn within the countdown. No time is deducted and it is not a failure.
room.downgradeTitle: The avatar cannot recover right now
room.downgradeBody: Switch to a text interview instead? After switching, avatar credits are no longer consumed; spoken items are marked as not assessed.
room.downgradeDeclineHint: Ending marks the round evaluation incomplete (not a failure). System-caused reserved credits are fully refunded.
room.authPaused: Sign-in needs to be confirmed again
room.authPausedHint: The timer is paused. No time is deducted and it is not a failure.

result.passedTitle: You passed this round. The next round is now unlocked.
result.passedDesc: Your total and all critical dimensions meet the 60-point threshold.
result.failedDesc: A cumulative review and training entry are ready. After training you can request a formal retry.
result.incompleteDesc: This is not a failure. Reason: {reason}. Saved content remains available; system-caused credits were refunded.
result.refunded: System-caused: reserved credits for this round were fully refunded.

report.title: Interview training report
report.desc: Per-question evidence, six-dimension scores and role match. For mock training only.
report.jobMatchNoJd: No JD provided; match percentage is not shown
report.question: Question
report.inputModeNote: Input mode: {mode}. Spoken items follow text-mode rules with evidence limitations noted.
report.exportDisclaimer: Mock training result. It is not a real hiring decision from any employer.
report.partialNote: Some modules failed to generate. You can retry these modules individually: {modules}

practice.title: Practice
practice.desc: Practice the original question or a variant targeting this round's weak dimensions.
practice.noScoreChange: Practice never changes your official score or unlock status
practice.endDialogBody: Practice content produces no official evidence and never changes scores.

library.title: Resumes, roles and training records
library.deleteActiveWarning: A formal interview is active on another device. Deleting will terminate it.

settings.title: Account, language and consents
settings.unbindWarning: Unlinking requires re-verification with the target method. Identity conflicts are never auto-merged.
settings.languagesNote: The two languages are independent. The interview language is confirmed again per project.
settings.consentDesc: Each consent is independent and revocable; withdrawal takes effect immediately. Core-service processing is on by default.
settings.exportHint: Exports include the full training history with a training-use label.
settings.deleteAccountHint: After deletion, content is irreversibly anonymised. Legal financial records are kept but unlinked from content.
settings.deleteAccountDialogBody: Deletion progress is shown honestly. Please export anything you want to keep first.

billing.title: Credits and subscription
billing.desc: Transparent pricing: rounds, total duration, formal retry and taxes. Payment never changes scoring.
billing.proPlanDesc: Monthly minutes + at most one period carried over

org.configHint: Configure roles, rounds, difficulty, duration, language, tools and deadlines.
org.notConfigurable: These can never be configured: the 60-point line, unified scoring algorithm, protected-attribute rules, evidence standards, cross-round unlocks and formal review.
org.neverShowFailure: Failure is never shown without authorisation.
org.inviteMethods: Invite link / organisation email / batch list / SSO / SCIM
org.joinNotice: Before joining, you see the organisation name, visible data, training period and exit impact.
org.smallGroupHidden: Groups with fewer than 10 people are hidden.
org.noRanking: No personal leaderboards, rankings or candidate search.
org.roleOwners: Owner / Admin / Coach / Privacy auditor / Finance / Candidate
org.auditHint: See which staff accessed what data, and when.
org.shareScopeHint: E.g. "radar chart only, 30 days"; expires automatically.
org.exitOrgHint: After leaving, organisation access is revoked immediately.

admin.anonymized: Anonymous session IDs and technical metrics only by default.
admin.noPersonalData: No control in this console can edit personal scores or unlock states.
admin.noEavesdrop: Operations can never listen in or answer on your behalf.
admin.providerNote: Changes include version, description, tests, approval and rollback. Full rollout is blocked until offline-shadow-canary passes.
admin.contentSafety: Source credibility / expiry / takedown / copyright complaints
admin.contentNote: Configuring bypasses of site terms, logins, CAPTCHAs or anti-bot measures is forbidden.
admin.ticketDefault: Minimal visibility by default: account state, orders, credits, fault codes and user-submitted material.
admin.transcriptAccess: Transcript access needs per-session authorisation; media access needs a user request plus two-person approval.
admin.refundWorkflow: Fault refunds, two-person approval for large refunds, duplicate-charge handling.
admin.auditAppendOnly: Append-only audit logs that admins cannot delete; break-glass access records with after-the-fact review.
